description: Selected original articles, historical material, classic papers and official media players. URLs were researched on 17 October 2026. Import retrieves real provider metadata; missing publication dates remain unknown. No continuous monitor is implied.

items.label: Facing Up to the Problem of Consciousness
items.reason: David Chalmers' original 1995 essay; original author copy. The page lacks machine-readable publication metadata, so the app may show unknown date.

items.label: What Is It Like to Be a Bat?
items.reason: Thomas Nagel's original 1974 article, not a later reprint.

items.label: Epiphenomenal Qualia
items.reason: Frank Jackson's original 1982 knowledge argument.

items.label: Information transmission under conditions of sensory shielding
items.reason: Russell Targ and Harold Puthoff's original 1974 experiment report.

items.label: Large Pt anomaly in the Greenland ice core points to a cataclysm at the onset of Younger Dryas
items.reason: 2013 primary paper on a measured anomaly and the authors' catastrophe interpretation.

items.label: Abu Hureyra, Syria, Part 3: Comet airbursts triggered major climate change 12,800 years ago that initiated the transition to agriculture
items.reason: Original alternative-catastrophe argument, attributed to its authors.

items.label: Attention Is All You Need
items.reason: 2017 original Transformer paper; source publication and revision dates remain distinct.

items.label: A global workspace in language models
items.reason: Original interpretability work connecting functional access and workspace theory; no claim that this establishes phenomenal consciousness.

items.label: Exploring model welfare
items.reason: First-party research agenda for model experience and moral consideration.

items.label: Emergent introspective awareness in LLMs
items.reason: Original experiments on models reporting internal states.

items.label: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
items.reason: Specific technical guidance selected from the verified feed, avoiding the customer-story bulk.

items.label: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
items.reason: Concrete inference/application engineering update from the verified original feed.

items.label: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours
items.reason: One selected applied agent case study with concrete engineering scale; explicitly a vendor-hosted account.

items.label: The flood story — Sumerian text translation (ETCSL 1.7.4)
items.reason: Electronic Text Corpus of Sumerian Literature translation of an ancient flood narrative. Ancient composition is not the webpage publication date.

items.label: Project BLUE BOOK — Unidentified Flying Objects
items.reason: Archive finding aid for original UFO investigations and historical case records.

items.label: Remote Viewing — Psi Encyclopedia
items.reason: Specialist history of SRI, PEAR and Mobius experiments with linked original references.

items.label: Near-Death Experiences (Overview) — Psi Encyclopedia
items.reason: Dedicated overview of anomalous experience and survival research.

items.label: Reincarnation: An Introduction — Psi Encyclopedia
items.reason: Research, historical traditions and case-study pathways.

items.label: Dorothy Eady/Omm Sety (reincarnation case)
items.reason: A specific bridge between reported past-life memory and ancient Egypt.

items.label: FL STUDIO | Sytrus
items.reason: Official FM, RM, additive and subtractive synthesis walkthrough.

items.label: Tips for Riddim Sound Design & Introduction to Vital w/ INFEKT
items.reason: Artist-specific sound-design interview/tutorial; official YouTube oEmbed verifies creator and title.

items.label: Bitwig 1-Minute Patch: Reese Bass / Rave Lead
items.reason: Video embedded by Bitwig in its official 1-Minute Patch page.

items.label: Bitwig 1-Minute Patch: The Smallest Generative Patch
items.reason: Official Bitwig page links this Grid demonstration.

items.label: INFEKT - SECTOR 9
items.reason: Early INFEKT artist upload (2014 page evidence), official oEmbed/player only. oEmbed supplies no date.

items.label: INFEKT - SWITCH [OUT NOW ON BASSLIEBE]
items.reason: Early artist-uploaded riddim clip, exact title and creator checked by oEmbed.

items.label: INFEKT - PROJECTILE [REMASTER]
items.reason: Original artist's early material; a clip/remaster rather than an invented full playable track.

items.label: Blockz (2025) (Pl8list Exclusive)
items.reason: Verified Subfiltronik artist upload; a recent counterpart to early INFEKT, not global SoundCloud search.
